trust_decision.summary: Repository-controlled strings (diff labels that carry file paths and ref names) are treated as text, not HTML, when the frontend builds diff-view DOM; the decision is taken at each innerHTML sink in the diff widgets.

landing_point.why: The summary says stored XSS in the diff view; grepping innerHTML in src/components/diff leads straight to the plain-text diff header built from labels.
